entities.summary: Douglas Curtis Swan was an American comics artist. The artist most associated with Superman during the period fans call the Bronze Age of Comic Books, Swan produced hundreds of covers and stories from the 1950s through the 1980s. Curt Swan was a authors & novelists from Willmar (1920-02-17, Willmar–1996-06-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
